clusters.rationale: Both items operate on the same Mellin-cone Connes-Moscovici s=3 residue machinery at L_max=8,10,12 evaluated against monotone Cauchy-decay / asymptotic-convergence criteria. Item 64 runs the test (re-audits w_0 branches and evaluates CM s=3 residues across {ζ, Zubarev, alternative regulator}); item 134 is the conditional re-choice if item 64's ζ-regulator check fails, consuming W1a-3 SV2 CC-v output and broadening the regulator family to heat-kernel / Dixmier-trace. Same spectral-functional-family question on same L grid, same CM s=3 residue dataset.

clusters.label: HP^1(A_F) dimension / generating-set: un-twisted baseline + CM-2008 twisted extension
clusters.rationale: Item 58 computes rank HP^1(A_F) for A_F = C + H + M_3(C) via direct Connes-Moscovici Hopf-cyclic reduction on the un-twisted algebra, and asks whether [ε_H] generates HP^1. Item 49 extends the same HP^1 computation to the twisted case, sweeping 16 admissible CM-2008 twists θ and projecting ch_θ onto HP^1_θ. Item 49 explicitly takes item 58's baseline (un-twisted HP^1 structure on A_F) as the reference against which the twisted projection ratio is evaluated. Same cohomology degree (HP^1), same algebra (A_F), direct input/output dependence. Conservative merge honored — HP^3 (item 57) is deliberately kept separate because it is a different cohomology degree.

singletons.title: CC-3 Connes-Moscovici Dimension Spectrum Signed Residue Sum (PRIORITY 5)
singletons.rationale_as_singleton: The core CC-3 dimension-spectrum residue computation: enumerate Sd of D_K on Jensen-SU(3) at L_max=9, compute Res ζ_{D²}(s) at each pole, evaluate Λ_CC = Σ sign(Hopf_d) · Res. This is the defining CC-3 quantity. Per bucket instructions, CC-3 residue computation is distinct from upstream prerequisites (S83 W1-G3 dim H_π closure) and downstream Hopf-cocycle sign pairing. None of the other 7 items compute Λ_CC directly — 64/134 compute s=3 residues for convergence diagnostics (different purpose), 49/58 compute HP^* on A_F (different algebra and different invariant), 57 is HP^3, 99 consumes the CC3 identity as derived input, 18 is unrelated Landau OP.

singletons.title: HP^3 extension: three-way disjoint-corridor theorem.
singletons.rationale_as_singleton: Locates or vanishes the H^3(F_Jensen) class via 3-cocycle basis of HC^3(A_F) and δ_2 Godbillon-Vey secondary characteristic. Degree-3 Hopf-cyclic cohomology is structurally distinct from degree-1 (items 49, 58) — different dimension, different generators (H_1 Hopf algebra's δ_2 vs X,Y derivations relevant to HP^1). Conservative merge rule retains the degree separation: HP^1 and HP^3 are different invariants of A_F even though both live in the Connes-Moscovici Hopf-cyclic framework.

singletons.title: S85-BASELINE-HTILDE-DERIVATION (TD-vs-LI divergence chase)
singletons.rationale_as_singleton: Downstream derivation of H̃ via two independent routes (Connes-Marcolli zeta canonical TD vs. Zubarev LI) to reconcile a 240× divergence and land H̃ in the W1a-1 PASS window. Consumes the CC3 identity d(ln A_s)/d(ln H̃) = +2 as given input, but does NOT compute the CC-3 signed-residue sum itself. Per bucket instructions, downstream computations that consume a CC-3 identity as scaffolding are distinct from the CC-3 residue computation proper. No HP^* content, no Mellin-cone convergence diagnostic. Stands alone as the H̃ two-route reconciliation task.
